creative_direction.name: Silver Pleat Etching Plaque
creative_direction.brief: 把凹槽玻璃的竖棱放大成整面蚀刻：鼠尾草绿平涂卡纸上，细密深绿竖凹线自顶垂落，在下三分之一处被一道硬边留白带截断，如同棱纹沉入铭牌；商品被提至上幅，竖棱从其肩后继续垂落却不触碰标签。下幅留出完整宽铭牌带：宽距 Arial 品牌字居带顶，Century Gothic 几何大写题名以近满带宽居中统领，一条石墨细线横于带顶如蚀刻刀痕。无地面无 horizon，纯线密度下坠叙事，对抗银盖的镜面碎光。
creative_direction.material: flat matte card with fine engraved vertical fluting lines and one hard-edge blank plaque band
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff

background.prompt: Seamless flat matte card in medium sage green, fine engraved vertical fluting lines in darker olive grey falling from the top edge, one hard-edge blank horizontal plaque band without lines across the lower third, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients beyond engraved lines, no objects

spec.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff
